# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant  <sub>[v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v4 c34 P14](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds Harbor, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c5 P1](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0001), [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>; Jemmy  <sub>[v4 c35 P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Jem is a healthy, plump baby boy with hazel eyes and red-tinted hair. He is noted for his well-shaped ears that lie flat against his head, as well as his dimpled elbows. He is eventually shortened into little dresses as he grows out of his infant clothes.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v4 c34 P12](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0012), [v4 c34 P14](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0014), [v4 c34 P16](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0016), [v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017), [v4 c35 P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005), [v4 c40 P15](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0015)_

## Personality

He is a cheerful and healthy infant who rarely cries and thrives happily. He is very affectionate and responsive toward his mother and those around him, often smiling and clinging to their hands.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v4 c34 P12](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0012), [v4 c35 P23](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0023), [v4 c36 P35](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0035)_

## Traits

- Cheerful and good-natured  <sub>[v4 c34 P23](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0023), [v4 c35 P23](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0023)</sub>
- Affectionate  <sub>[v4 c34 P12](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0012), [v4 c36 P29](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0029)</sub>

## History

Little Jem was born at dawn on a early autumn morning in the little house of dreams at Four Winds Harbor to Anne and Gilbert Blythe. He was named James Matthew after Captain Jim and Matthew Cuthbert, who were regarded as the finest gentlemen his mother had ever known. As a baby, he was doted upon by his parents, as well as Leslie Moore, Susan Baker, Marilla, and Captain Jim, the latter of whom left his curious treasures to the child in his will. When he was about a year old, his parents decided to relocate to the Morgan place at Glen St. Mary, and he moved there with his family.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 c34 P28](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0028), [v4 c35 P40](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0040), [v4 c36 P29](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0029), [v4 c40 P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058)_
